decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Unnumbered Location Plan; Unnumbered Drainage Report. Received 16/02/2018. Stage 1 Road Safety Audit. Received 22/06/2018. XXXX. Received 20/07/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition of the existing boundary treatment at the site shall take place unless agreed in advance in writing by the local planning authority by the submission of an application for planning permission, including details of the proposed replacement boundary treatment.

Condition : 4 - Before the hereby approved use commences, the redundant section of the dropped kerb on Fairfields Road shall be reinstated to a footway, as well as the new section of the crossover shall be completed, as shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 5 - The landowner shall plant two semi-mature Silver Birch Trees (Betula pendula) of an appropriate size (over 4 metres high and the trunk girth, measured 1 metres from the ground level measuring no less than 16 centimetres) in the locations shown on the approved drawings. The trees shall be planted in the next planting season and shall be subject to appropriate levels of maintenance to ensure that they are successfully established on site. Should either of the trees die or become seriously damaged or moribund within the first five years after they have been planted, then a further replacement tree to the same specification shall be planted immediately.
description: Layout of land to create an 11 bay car park with space for one disabled bay.
